title: Curtain index
description: A full-area curtain opens into an oversized editorial index, with a short stagger between entries.
useCase: Occasional portfolio or publication navigation with a strong typographic identity.
interaction: Open Index, select a section, or close with Escape
reducedMotion: The menu opens and closes immediately, including keyboard-triggered changes.
limitations: Local section selection, not a router. The curtain is contained in its parent and does not act as a page-wide modal.
look: Deep plum full-bleed panel listing three oversized pink italic serif section names between hairline rules, with a small text toggle and thin X icon.
motion: Opening drops a plum curtain from the top (scaleY, 380 ms ease-in-out) while the hamburger morphs to an X and entries fade and slide down, staggered 35 ms apart.
adapt: The curtain is `.ci-curtain` (`scaleY` on a .38s transition), entries delay by `transition-delay:calc(100ms + var(--order)*35ms)`, and `.ci-toggle b` bars rotate into the X; all key off `data-open`. Replace `sections` and the ellipse artwork, and route in `close`.
